title: Checkpoint: Order Pipeline Wired
prompt:
Implement the pipeline described in the checkpoint (TinyContainer is provided — same API as the lesson's Container):

```csharp
static string Process(decimal amount);                       // runs the resolved processor
static Solution.OrderProcessor BuildProcessor(IOrderRepository repo, IAuditLog audit);
```

tests.name: valid order flows through
tests.hint: Process delegates to the processor: validate -> save -> audit -> format "ok:<id>".

tests.name: invalid order short-circuits
tests.hint: Validator runs first; rejection skips save and audit.

tests.name: composition root returns a working graph
tests.hint: Each BuildProcessor call wires fresh services around the SAME repo/audit instances passed in.
